entries.name: Man raising a gavel beside cargo and sailing ships
entries.evidence: reference crop in source/tracing.json for the existing PDF page161 impression, No.228
entries.observed: Standing figure raises a short-handled mallet above the cargo; other figures gather around. Ship masts stand behind. The earlier label sailor was too specific and omitted the gavel.
entries.interpretation: Auction is a descriptive search term suggested by the gavel, goods and gathered figures; no personal identity asserted.
